current_rule: A source document alone does not establish implementation, tests or evidence; every imported source must remain provenance-addressable.
required_alignment_checks: tasks map to observable repository work
knowledge maps to explicit domain contracts
skills map to executable or testable capabilities
evidence maps to reproducible verification artifacts
security-source provenance is registered with immutable blob references
security and accessibility controls are traceable to implementation and independent evidence

evidence_requirements.release_rule: No release claim without reproducible evidence for every required dimension; UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/ENVIRONMENT remain non-passing.

completion_criteria.requirement: Project completion is a verified state, not a documentation milestone.
